Our Story

settings.title:
Built to Bridge the Gap
Between IT and Business

settings.editor: Folio3 was founded in 2005 with a belief that technology should drive business growth, not create friction. For 20 years, we’ve helped enterprises across industries build reliable technology environments.
Our Managed IT division combines enterprise expertise with dedicated support, managing thousands of endpoints across 8 countries with a proven track record of zero client breaches.
Folio3 Software Inc. founded in San Jose, California
Expanded to UK & Pakistan; first international offices opened
Reached 100+ enterprise clients across manufacturing and finance
Launched dedicated Managed IT Services division
Achieved ISO 27001 & SOC 2 Type II security certifications
Expanded to 8 global offices · 500+ managed IT clients worldwide
What We Stand For
These aren't values on a wall. They're the standards we hold ourselves to in every client engagement.
We measure success by business outcomes, not ticket volume. Every recommendation, decision, and solution is aligned with your goals, priorities, and long-term technology needs.
We continuously refine systems through regular reviews, roadmap planning, and engineering improvements. Our approach helps businesses maintain reliable, secure, and scalable technology environments.
We maintain high standards across every engagement, focusing on quality delivery, technical accuracy, and solutions that improve infrastructure performance while supporting business objectives.
We provide clear communication, straightforward reporting, and complete visibility into our work. You always understand what is being done, why it matters, and how it supports your goals.
Security is integrated into every engagement through proactive controls, risk awareness, and best practices. We help protect systems while maintaining operational efficiency and compliance readiness.
We focus on preventing issues before they disrupt operations through continuous monitoring, proactive maintenance, and early identification of potential technology risks.
Trusted IT Management Support
Real-world outcomes from organizations improving their support experience, security posture, and confidence in their systems.

“We’ve been extremely impressed with Folio3’s outsourced IT support team. They’ve taken the time to understand our people and operations, delivering seamless, reliable support and clear communication. Most importantly, they’ve become a true extension of our IT team, strengthening both our technical capabilities and the support experience we provide.”
